editorNote: Two themes today. Privacy and policy: Meta paused sharing in Muse after shared chats turned up on the open web, the US told federal agencies to remove DeepSeek, and Anthropic floated a safety bill that would let a model be blocked over mass-casualty risk. Infrastructure: PyTorch introduced TorchTPU for running on TPUs, and NVIDIA published more on securing agents at runtime. OpenAI buying Orchestra Bio rounds out the news.
